description: Flat record-level metadata schema for single amplified genome (SAG) data from archaeal communities collected from extreme environments such as hydrothermal vents, including sampling context, environmental parameters, lysis and amplification methods, sequencing technology, and genome assembly workflow.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual SAG/metagenomic record within the dataset.

sample_id.descr: Original sample identifier assigned at collection or processing time.

site_name.descr: Name of the sampling site or locality (for example, hydrothermal vent field name).

site_type.descr: Environment category of the sampling site; examples include hydrothermal vent, hot spring, acidic mine drainage, hypersaline brine, or deep-sea sediment.

depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below sea level, ground surface, or water column reference as applicable.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collector_or_institution.descr: Name of the person, cruise, laboratory, or institution that collected the sample.

sample_matrix.descr: Physical sample matrix or material collected; examples include water, sediment, biofilm, chimney deposit, or microbial mat.

temperature_c.descr: Temperature at collection site in degrees Celsius (°C).

pH.descr: Measured pH of the sampled environment at collection.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity at collection, in practical salinity units (PSU).

pressure_mpa.descr: Ambient pressure at collection site in megapascals (MPa), if measured or inferred.

oxygen_status.descr: Redox/oxygen condition of the environment; examples include oxic, microoxic, anoxic, or unknown.

redox_potential_mv.descr: Redox potential (Eh) at collection, in millivolts (mV), if available.

conductivity_ms_cm.descr: Electrical conductivity of the sample or site water in mS/cm, if measured.

source_vent_fluid_chemistry.descr: Free-text or standardized description of relevant geochemical parameters of vent fluid or site water, such as sulfide, methane, iron, or hydrogen concentrations.

cell_enrichment_method.descr: Method used to enrich or isolate cells prior to single-cell processing; for example, filtration, flow sorting, microfluidics, or dilution-to-extinction.

cell_lysis_method.descr: Method used for cell lysis before amplification; examples include alkaline lysis, enzymatic lysis, thermal lysis, or combined protocols.

cell_lysis_kit.descr: Name and version of the lysis kit or reagent system used, if applicable.

cell_lysis_protocol_version.descr: Version, protocol identifier, or manufacturer protocol reference for the lysis method.

amplification_method.descr: Whole-genome amplification method used; commonly multiple displacement amplification (MDA) or other isothermal amplification approaches.

amplification_kit.descr: Commercial kit or reagent system used for amplification, including manufacturer and product name.

amplification_kit_lot.descr: Lot or batch number of the amplification kit or reagents, if tracked.

amplification_input_ng.descr: Amount of DNA or cell material input to amplification, in nanograms (ng), if known.

amplification_cycles.descr: Number of amplification cycles or equivalent amplification rounds, if applicable.

amplification_date.descr: Date on which amplification was performed, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform or instrument used; examples include Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, NextSeq, PacBio Sequel II, or Oxford Nanopore PromethION.

sequencing_technology.descr: Sequencing chemistry or read technology; examples include paired-end short reads, long reads, HiFi, or nanopore reads.

sequencing_library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit used prior to sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_library_strategy.descr: Library strategy used; examples include shotgun, paired-end, mate-pair, or long-read single-molecule sequencing.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs (bp) for the sequencing run, if applicable.

sequencing_depth_mreads.descr: Approximate number of reads generated for this record, in millions of reads, if known.

sequencing_date.descr: Date the sequencing run was performed or completed, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

basecaller_or_primary_processing_softwar.descr: Software used for initial basecalling or primary read processing, if relevant.

assembly_software.descr: Genome assembly software used; examples include SPAdes, MEGAHIT, Unicycler, Flye, or metaSPAdes.

assembly_software_version.descr: Version of the genome assembly software.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key non-default assembly parameters or command-line options used, recorded as free text.

post_assembly_polishing_software.descr: Software used for polishing assembled contigs or genomes, if any.

contamination_filtering_software.descr: Software or method used to detect and remove contaminant sequences, if any.

binning_software.descr: Software used for genome binning or single-cell genome reconstruction, if applicable.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness as a percentage (%), based on the chosen quality assessment method.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination as a percentage (%).

strain_heterogeneity_percent.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity or microdiversity as a percentage (%), if reported.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs in the assembled genome.

total_assembled_bp.descr: Total length of the assembled genome in base pairs (bp).

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the assembled genome as a percentage (%).

domain.descr: Taxonomic domain assignment; expected value for this dataset is Archaea.

taxonomy_assignment_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic assignment, such as GTDB-Tk, 16S rRNA classification, or marker-gene comparison.

functional_annotation_software.descr: Software used for genome annotation or functional prediction, if applicable.

functional_annotation_database.descr: Reference database used for functional annotation; examples include KEGG, COG, Pfam, eggNOG, or GTDB.

biosynthetic_or_metabolic_pathways.descr: Free-text list or standardized description of key metabolic or biosynthetic pathways inferred from the genome, relevant to adaptation in extreme environments.

evidence_for_ecosystem_function.descr: Summary of inferred roles in ecosystem biochemical processes; examples include sulfur cycling, methane metabolism, hydrogen oxidation, or carbon fixation.

qc_pass.descr: Indicates whether the record passed the study's quality-control criteria for inclusion in downstream analyses.

notes.descr: Additional record-level notes, exceptions, or protocol deviations that are important for interpretation.
